مَرْقَعٌ [A place of patching; or a place to be patched; as also ↓ مُتَرَقَّعٌ ]. ―
-b2- [Hence,] مَا رَقَعَ مَرْقَعًا: see 1. ―
-b3- And لَا أَجِدُ فِيكَ مَرْقَعًا لِلْكَلَامِ (tropical:) [I do not, or shall not, find in thee anything requiring amendment, to speak of]. (TA.) ―
-b4- And فِيهِ لِمَنْ يُصْلِحُهُ ↓ مُتَرَقَّعٌ (assumed tropical:) (assumed tropical:) In it, or him, is a place, or subject, for patching, or amendment, for him who will rectify it, or him: like as one says, فِيهِ مُتَنَصَّحٌ, meaning a place for sewing. (TA.) ―
-b5- And ↓ أَرَى فِيهِ مُتَرَقَّعًا (tropical:) I see in him, or it, a subject, or place, for censure, reviling, or satire. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
